모델: E64 서비스 — LAB 편 전체를 영상으로(제작 절차 lab-whole-video). 공통 글은 영상시험_20261125/지시문.json의 공통 글에서 그 편만의 소품(양머리 수건)과 빛 색(금빛)을 이 편 것으로 바꾸고, 만화 효과 · 김을 막는 줄을 더했다
공통: One continuous shot, no cuts. The camera is locked off exactly as in the start frame: no zoom, no pan, no tilt, no shake. Keep the exact handmade needle-felt miniature look of the start frame in every frame: fine wool felt fibres, visible stitches, matte felt and wool; every object keeps its shape, size and colour and never turns into a realistic thing. MONGLE is the coral-pink felt blob. Mongle has NO mouth, NO arms, NO legs, NO hands and NO neck, ever: no mouth ever opens or appears on it, no limbs ever grow. It moves only by tilting, squashing, stretching and bouncing its whole soft dome body, and shows feeling only with its two glossy black bead eyes (they can grow bigger and rounder, or squeeze shut into two short dark stitched lines) and by its coral wool flushing red. LOOK: the same warm red-lantern light and colours as the start frame, unchanged to the last frame. Nothing new appears that is not in the start frame. No speed lines, no motion lines, no cartoon effects, no steam, no smoke. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. No sound.

클립.prompt: The felt Korean-Chinese restaurant from the start frame: the owner in his white chef's jacket and red apron on the left, Mongle on the round table on the right with its half-eaten bowl of jjajangmyeon behind it, and its small flat mustard-yellow felt wallet lying on the front of the table just left of Mongle's hem. ACTION: From 0 to 1.0 s the owner sets the plate of golden felt dumplings down on the back half of the table and lets go. From 1.0 to 2.0 s he straightens up a little with a big proud warm grin, his left hand dropping to his side while he moves his RIGHT felt hand down and forward and lays it flat, palm down, on the front of the table just left of the wallet, exactly as in the end frame; it rests there until the end. From 1.0 to 2.0 s Mongle's bead eyes follow the plate. At about 2.2 s Mongle only tilts its dome a little toward the owner and looks up at him, puzzled, eyes a little rounder. Mongle stays sitting flat on the table the whole time: its scalloped hem always rests on the table top, it never stands up and nothing grows under it. The wallet, the bowl and the chopsticks never move.

Medium close on the table from the start frame: the owner's white jacket and red apron at the left edge with his felt hand resting flat on the table, the plate of golden felt dumplings further back, the flat mustard-yellow felt wallet on the empty front of the table, and Mongle on the right with a small pale-blue felt sweat bead, its hem just touching the wallet. ACTION: From 0 to 1.0 s Mongle glances back at the dumplings, then toward the owner's hand, its wool flushing slightly, bead eyes wide and worried. From 1.2 to 3.2 s Mongle's whole dome body slides slowly to the LEFT along the table top like a soft felt bulldozer (Mongle starts on the right of the empty front of the table, no plate in its way), pressing the flat yellow wallet ahead of it with the front of its scalloped hem; the wallet stays flat on the table and slides left in a straight line until its left edge bumps gently against the owner's fingertips, exactly as in the end frame. Mongle's outline stays one smooth round dome the whole time — nothing ever sticks out of its body: no arm, no tentacle, no tongue, no stub. The wallet never lifts, never tips up and never floats. From 3.3 s to the end Mongle stays there, leaning a little forward, eyes big, round and hopeful, trembling very slightly, waiting. The owner's hand does not move. The plate and the dumplings never move.

The same felt restaurant table from the start frame: the owner standing behind the table on the left, his right felt hand resting flat on the front of the table with Mongle's flat yellow wallet touching his fingertips, the plate of golden felt dumplings behind, and Mongle sitting on the table just right of the wallet with a small pale-blue felt sweat bead. ACTION: From 0 to 0.8 s the owner looks down at the wallet, eyebrows up. At about 0.9 s he bursts into a hearty warm laugh, his eyes squeezing into happy curves and his shoulders shaking. From 1.2 to 2.0 s he raises his LEFT felt hand palm-out and waves it side to side in a friendly 'no, no'. From 2.0 to 3.0 s, with the fingertips of his RIGHT hand, he pushes the flat yellow wallet back along the table to the right until it rests against Mongle's hem again. From 3.0 s Mongle's two bead eyes grow bigger and rounder and its coral wool flushes pink; it gives one small happy bounce in place, hem landing back flat on the table. Mongle's face is ONLY two glossy black bead eyes — no mouth, no smile line, no stitch or mark of any kind ever appears below or between the eyes. The owner keeps laughing kindly to the end. The plate never moves. Mongle never grows arms or legs.

Wide shot of the felt restaurant from the start frame, a few minutes later: in the background a young felt tourist in a sky-blue hoodie sits at the second round table with his bowl of jjajangmyeon and his own flat green felt wallet, the owner standing beside that table setting down a plate of golden felt dumplings; in the foreground Mongle sits on its own table with a plate of two dumplings and its yellow wallet. ACTION: From 0 to 1.0 s the owner sets the plate of dumplings down in front of the tourist and straightens up with his proud grin. From 1.2 to 2.0 s the tourist looks at the dumplings, then up at the owner, surprised. From 2.2 to 3.4 s the tourist picks up his flat green wallet in both hands and holds it out toward the owner, worried. In the foreground Mongle keeps facing the camera the whole time and never turns around; only its two bead eyes glance up toward the tourist's table. From 3.2 to 4.6 s Mongle sways its dome gently left and right twice, calm and knowing, a little flushed, its hem staying flat on the table. Mongle's face is only its two bead eyes — no mouth ever. From 4.6 s the owner laughs and gently pushes the tourist's wallet back down with one hand, and the tourist smiles. Mongle never grows arms or legs.
